section_summary.extract_value: This section describes post-test and two-week follow-up measures for a single experimental session (no explicit 'Study 1' label). State measures collected after the manipulation included a modified I-PANAS-SF with a guilt item, PASTAS for body anxiety, and an adapted BREQ-2 introjected regulation subscale; height and weight were self-reported and BMI was calculated (available for 150 participants). Trait measures were collected online two weeks later (n = 130).
